# Lab 20.6: Scan Container Images for CVEs

## What We Are Going to Do
Push an old container image to Artifact Registry, read the vulnerabilities found by automatic scanning, and run an on-demand scan.

## Steps

1. **Enable the APIs and create a repository.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable artifactregistry.googleapis.com containerscanning.googleapis.com ondemandscanning.googleapis.com
gcloud artifacts repositories create lab-repo --repository-format=docker --location=us-central1
gcloud auth configure-docker us-central1-docker.pkg.dev --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Push an old image on purpose.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">export REPO=us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/$PROJECT_ID/lab-repo
docker pull nginx:1.18
docker tag nginx:1.18 $REPO/nginx:old
docker push $REPO/nginx:old</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **See the scan results.** After a few minutes:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud artifacts docker images list $REPO --show-occurrences \
  --format="table(package,version,vuln_counts)"

gcloud artifacts docker images describe $REPO/nginx:old \
  --show-package-vulnerability --format="yaml(package_vulnerability_summary)"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Look in the console.** Open **Artifact Registry → lab-repo → nginx → old → Vulnerabilities**. Each CVE shows severity, package and whether a fix exists.

5. **Run an on-demand scan.** This also works for images that are not in Artifact Registry.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud artifacts docker images scan $REPO/nginx:old --remote \
  --format="value(response.scan)" &gt; scan_id.txt
gcloud artifacts docker images list-vulnerabilities $(cat scan_id.txt) \
  --format="table(vulnerability.effectiveSeverity,vulnerability.packageIssue[0].affectedPackage)" | head -20</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **Compare with a newer image.** Push `nginx:stable-alpine` and compare the counts.

7. **Keep the repository** for the next labs.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Automatic scan | Runs on every push |
| Old image | Many vulnerabilities, some critical |
| On-demand scan | Same data, when you ask |
| Updated base image | Far fewer vulnerabilities |
